text:
Marta (People Ops): Heads-up: planning a month-end "Thank You Pop" on Friday 3:30pm. Small cards + redeemable token stickers. Goal: quick appreciation ritual for cross-team helpers. Who can help run it? :sparkles:
Jana (HR): Quick policy check: if a manager asks to convert a token to a small spot award later, what's the flow? Need to keep audit records.
Marta (People Ops): We'll keep it as swag-first. If conversion happens, we'll attach the original nomination and run it through spot-award form. Jana, can you post the form link?
Jana (HR): Yes. I'll confirm the conversion note and post the spot-award request link by EOD. Also recommend optional anonymity on nominations.
Devon - Eng: Love it. How will nominations be collected? Anonymous form + paper cards at the table?
Marta (People Ops): Exactly. 48-hr anonymous form + paper cards on the day. Form fields: nominee (required), one-line why (optional), anonymous toggle.
Aria - Design: I can make an 8.5x11 poster and a Slack GIF. Want the look to be low-key, warm — maybe pastel stickers and a tiny heart icon.
Olive (Facilities): I can reserve the south lounge table and order light snacks. Need final headcount by Thursday 11am. Also need two volunteers for setup.
Marta (People Ops): Volunteer shifts: setup 3:00-3:25, host 3:25-4:15, teardown 4:15-4:30. Who can do setup?
Devon - Eng: I can do teardown 4:15-4:30. Happy to help.
Aria - Design: I'll do setup and bring printed cards + sticker sheet.
Jana (HR): I'll review the announcement wording and confirm the audit CSV structure. We should log each nomination's form ID in a central sheet in case of conversions.
kudos-bot: Auto: "Kudos: Priya nominated for last-mile bug fix that saved a release! :tada:"
Marta (People Ops): Great. Action items: Aria poster by Wed, form live Wed 9am, Olive confirms snacks by Thu 11am, Jana posts spot-award link + audit checklist by EOD. I'll draft the announcement tomorrow. Thanks!
notes: month-end pop-up appreciation; anonymous nominations; token-to-spot conversion process; volunteers; headcount deadline Thursday 11am
